name: Memelas
steps: Mix masa harina, warm water and salt into moist pliable dough; cover 20 minutes. Mash warm beans to a spreadable paste and shred the cheese.
Divide dough into eight. Pat each into a thick oval about 12 cm long. Cook on a hot dry griddle for 2 minutes per side until set but still pliable.
While warm, pinch a raised rim around each oval and three shallow ridges down its centre. Brush with a little oil and return to griddle for 2–3 minutes until the base lightly crisps.
Spread beans over each memela, add cheese, salsa and finely diced onion. Warm briefly to soften cheese and serve two per person.
tips: Pinch the rim while the masa is warm; once cool it cracks instead of holding the classic oval edge.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
